services.desc: Hampton Harbor Boat Tour - Explore the Beauty of the NH Seacoast Maximum 6 people Set sail on an unforgettable boat tour through the scenic waters of Hampton Harbor, NH! Whether you’re looking to soak in the coastal views, experience the local marine life, check out the sand bars, or enjoy a relaxing cruise along the picturesque shoreline, our guided tours offer something for everyone. Departing from Hampton Harbor, our journey will take you past charming waterfront homes, historic fishing docks, and the pristine beaches of the New Hampshire Seacoast.
